entities.summary:
Albert Maurice Hackett was an American actor, dramatist and screenwriter most noted for his collaborations with his partner and wife Frances Goodrich. Their film work includes the first three installments in the Thin Man series, 
It's a Wonderful Life, Easter Parade, Father of the Bride and Seven Brides for Seven Brothers.
